text:
ashwin: quick follow-up from the elastic credit allocator RFC — i have a couple interface/ownership questions that matter for rollout.

maria: thanks for flagging. can you summarize the two biggest gaps you see?

ashwin: sure. 1) who owns short-lived credit amortization logic (admission-service vs quota-shard). 2) how do we surface abuse signals upstream so admission can make informed soft-evict decisions without coupling to detector impl.

leah: fwiw i'm leaning toward keeping amortization in the quota shard (state locality + accurate accounting), admission should only request a provisional grant and accept a lease token. that keeps admission stateless-ish.

sam: +1 for state in shard but we need a small API contract. something like:

```
rpc RequestLease(Request) returns (Lease) {
  Request { tenant_id, desired_credits, max_latency_ms }
  Lease { granted_credits, lease_ttl_ms, amortization_hint }
}
```

ashwin: that proto looks ok. my worry: amortization_hint meaning varies across shard implementations (burst-friendly vs strict). we should standardize meaning or admission can't reason about soft evict thresholds.

maria: proposal: amortization_hint = {type: "windowed"|"decay", params: stringified-json}. admission interprets only the common fields: granted_credits and lease_ttl; for policy it only needs a small signal: "burstable" boolean + numeric steady_rate_estimate.

leah: that seems pragmatic. admission can then apply a generic soft-evict policy: if burstable==false && observed_usage > steady_rate_estimate * 2 -> preemptive-throttle.

infra-bot: deploy job #elastic-credit-v2 started on canary-clusters (zone-a)

sam: second big question: abuse signals. we don't want admission to pull raw detector state. suggested pattern: detectors emit compact signals into telemetry + an aggregated "abuse_score" per tenant which quota-shard can attach to Lease object.

ashwin: i like attaching a normalized abuse_score [0..100] to the Lease. admission uses it with a configured curve to decide whether to reduce leak_rate or shorten ttl.

maria: need to be careful with privacy/PII in that signal. keep it numeric and explain provenance in docs. and make the score optional.

leah: also add a version field for the score prototype so we can iterate without breaking admission logic.

sam: rollout plan idea: canary shards set abuse_score=null and emit telemetry. after 2 days we enable abuse_score attach for a small tenant cohort and watch false positives via eval prompts.

ashwin: test coverage we need: unit tests for lease protobuf parsing, integration test where quota-shard returns amortization_hint variations, and an e2e canary harness that simulates synthetic burst/abuse.

maria: ops: we should also add metrics + traces: lease_request_latency, lease_grant_ratio, attached_abuse_score_distribution, and a couple SLI alerts when grant_ratio drops unexpectedly in canary.

ops-bot: created ticket INF-4732 to add lease metrics dashboards

sam: one more long-term refactor thought: move to a sharded token-mgr service that owns both quota state and detector aggregation. gives us colocated signals and simplifies cross-shard borrowing later. downside: bigger migration and more deployment complexity.

leah: agreed it's appealing. we should prototype token-mgr in a single region and ensure its API is the same as the current quota-shard facade.

ashwin: ok next steps: 1) sam to submit small proto update PR with amortization_hint + abuse_score + score_version 2) maria to draft rollout plan (canary cohort + telemetry) 3) leah to write integration test spec. i'll sync with security about the abuse_score fields.

maria: will do. tagging @leah and @sam for PRs. :thumbsup:

sam: i'll open the PR by EOD and include a compatibility shim for older shards.

leah: i'll add the integration test template to the infra test harness.

ashwin: thanks all. i'll post a short RFC follow-up doc after the PR so product/ops can review the rollout plan.

infra-bot: deploy job #elastic-credit-v2 succeeded on canary-clusters (zone-a) :white_check_mark:

maria: nice, keeping an eye on grant_ratio dashboards now.

ashwin: last note — let's keep the admission-side policy config externalized (Console + feature flag) so we can tune curves without code changes.

leah: agreed.

sam: okay bye for now, will loop back after PR

ashwin: thanks :sparkles:
